findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the ice machine baffle to be soiled on the corners. Discussed with the PIC, and PIC immediately cleaned and sanitized the baffle. Ensure that baffles are cleaned regularly enough to keep them clean.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Two holes were observed in two different walls in the back area.  Walls shall be smooth, non absorbent, and easily cleanable.  Ensure holes are filled and sealed to prevent pest entry.
-Wall next to the alcohol cabinet where the hinge was previously attached
-Wall above and to the left of the soda boxes

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The mop sink is not attached to the wall and the wall paint and caulk is peeling and cracking.  Ensure the paint and previous caulk is removed and resealed to prevent moisture absorption and mold growth.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11 (P) Food employee used bare hands to handle ready to eat foods. Food employees shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas/tongs, dispensing equipment or single use gloves when handling ready to eat foods. Reference 3-301.11.

Observed bartender pick up drink granish with bare hands and place into customer's drink. Ensure gloves/tongs/single-use toothpicks are used to pick up garnishes to prepare drinks.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A)  (Pf) pizza oven food contact surface is soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

Observed large pizza oven behind bar (next to coffee maker) and two stacked pizza ovens (next to decorative chalkboard) to be heavily soiled with grease and food pieces. Ensure ovens are cleaned frequently to prevent soil accumulation. Will follow up with facility to ensure cleaning has occurred. Follow up: 6/5/2019.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Date marking is not on 1/2 gallon of milk and half-filled half and half. Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text:
7-102.11  (Pf) Working container of clear liquid in milk crate under handsink not properly labeled. Containers of toxic materials must be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. Person in charge labeled the container. Reference 7-102.11.

Observed a bottle of clear liquid with other cleaners/sanitizers unlabeled. Ensure all toxic substances are labeled appropriately.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text:
3-303.12  (C) Exposed food stored in contact with ice or water at bar area. Food may not be stored in direct contact with ice or water if the food is subject to direct contact with the ice or water. Reference 3-303.12.

Observed a bin of ice with a scoop for drinks overflowed with an adjacent container filled with ice housing canned beverages. Protect food (ice scooped for drink) from contamination by not storing canned/bottled beverages with it.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths used for wiping spills shall be maintained dry. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution. Cloths in-use for wiping surfaces in contact with raw animalfoods shall be kept separate from cloths used for other purposes. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Reference 3-304.14.
Observed damp cloths throughout bar area. All damp cloths must be stored in appropriate sanitizer bucket with appropriate concentration to prevent growth of pathogens.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed the ice bin behind the bar to be exposed. Provide a lid on the ice behind the bar.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no cholorine test kits in the facility. Provide cholorine test kits.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice deflector shield of the ice machine in the back storage room to be soiled with what appears to be mold. Clean the ice deflector shield in the back storage room.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the bottom of the refrigerator to be soiled with food debris. Clean the bottom of the refrigerator.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: The ice scoop for the machine in back is stored in a 5 gallon bucket which is soiled with old water in the bottom. 750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination. The ice scoop shall be stored properly so that it does not spread potential contaminants to the ice.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed ice scoop at bin behind bar  with the handle in the ice. 750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells. Store scoop properly.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: The plastic mat holding the rim salter is covered with a towel. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Remove towel and store properly.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: A large spoon in the clean utensil basket behind the bar is soiled. The soda gun at the bar is soiled with food debris.  750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time they may have become contaminated.  Properly clean and sanitize the above listed items.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: The tops of the coffin coolers are soiled with dust and the plastic liners are stuck to the tops in places. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.  Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Single use items are stored in such a way that they are not protected from contamination. 1) Straws on bar in holders are not wrapped  2) a box of cups on the floor in the storage area 3)single use forks are stored with eating and handle ends mixed.  750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law. Store single use items properly. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.
750-880 Single-service knives, forks and spoons packaged in bulk shall be inserted into holders to protect these items from contamination and present the handle of the utensils to the consumer unless the utensils are pre-wrapped or pre-packaged.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the beer tap is grossly soiled in the corner next to the bar and under a line on the floor. 750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors and maintain clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: See last routine inspection report

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: See last routine inspection report

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed half and half creamer in beer cooler to be not date marked. Any potentially hazardous food, ready to eat foods, that are not included as an exception must be date marked from the time of opening, if not being used within 24 hours.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed ice for mixed drinks to be uncovered. Make sure all ice used for consumption are covered.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed shelving and shelf mats to be rusting and soiled in walk-in cooler. Clean shelves and mats.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Ladies restroom left sink drips onto the floor.  Either there is a plumbing leak or the crack in the basin seems to be causing the leak.  Repair the cause of the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Gap at the bottom double doors (center to the right).  Seal this gap so no daylight shows.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Mold on floor around pipes and on pipes below 4-part sink. Clean floor and pipes.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
"Simply Right" hand sanitizer is on the back bar.  Only hand sanitizers approved by Illinois Department of Public Health for food-service use are allowed in food and drink preparation areas.  Sanitizer was removed.
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation

Repeat:  The ice bin behind the bar (east bin) was uncovered.  Cover the ice bin when not in use.

findings.comment:
Observed a scoop without a handle in the bulk pretzel container.  Use a scoop with a handle to avoid hand contact with the pretzels.
750-280 To avoid unnecessary manual contact with food, suitable dispensing utensils shall be used by employees or provided to consumers who serve themselves..

1. Repeat: Observed a build-up on both soda guns.  Clean and sanitize the soda guns and maintain clean. Corrected:  both soda guns cleaned.  2. Observed a stain on the cutting board at the prep cooler.  Clean the cutting board of the stain or discard the board.

750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
